**Tesla Model S – India**

> **Status:** Tesla has not yet launched the Model S (or any other Model) in India.  
> **Implication:** Because the vehicle isn’t officially available, there is no fixed retail price in the Indian market.  

If Tesla were to enter India, the price would likely be significantly higher than the U.S. MSRP due to import duties, taxes, and local assembly costs. Rough estimates from industry analysts suggest a launch price in the range of **₹1.4 – ₹1.6 crore** (≈ $180 – $200 k), but this is purely speculative until an official announcement is made.

**Bottom line:** As of now, you cannot purchase a Tesla Model S in India, so no official price exists.
